content:
alex: Quick idea — run an AB test: inline pricing estimator vs gated modal that captures email + company size. Goal: measure MQL lift and demo requests. Fig: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz
maria: love it. metrics? CAC impact? :chart_with_upwards_trend:
devon: recommend 3-step estimator: usage -> concurrency -> region -> est monthly cost
alex: sample microcopy for gated CTA:
```
Get a tailored cost estimate
Enter your email and org size to see projected monthly spend and recommended plan.
```
jess: prefer 'projected spend' not 'monthly spend' — less scary
samir: for tier naming we should map estimate bands to tiers: Starter (<$1k), Scale ($1k–$10k), Enterprise (>$10k)
pricingbot: New experiment created: EX-4387, tracking tag = pricing_estimator_gated
maria: A/B details: 50/50 traffic; primary KPI = demo request conversion within 7d; secondary = email capture rate; tertiary = avg estimated spend
devon: routing: if est > $10k, route to sales-sdr immediate; $1k–$10k -> outbound nurture; <$1k -> self-serve drip
alex: add utm campaign and hidden form field for model variant
jess: small ask: update FAQ entry "How do you calculate estimates?" with bullet on assumptions
alex: proposed FAQ blurb:
```
Estimates are calculated using token-based inference cost, concurrency assumptions (p95), and our recommended batch settings. We show a conservative monthly projection.
```
samir: can legal approve the "recommended plan" phrasing? @maria pls
maria: i'll run it past legal, ping back by EOD
devon: experiment duration 4 weeks, need analytics dashboard; @samir can you add funnel? 
samir: yes, will add funnel + event schema by tomorrow
alex: ok let's ship a quick prototype to staging today. I'll drop figma + staging link: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz and https://staging.redwood.ai/pricing-estimator
jess: tiny copy tweak: CTA -> "See my estimate" :thumbsup:
alex: thanks all. followups: devon build modal, samir analytics, maria legal, jess copy. I'll sync Thu 10am
maria: noted
pricingbot: Reminder: EX-4387 kickoff tomorrow 10:00
